recs.title: Your 10 recommended actions
items: Send one weekly newsletter. The 14 Oct draft ("3 New Buyer Requests incl. Urgent 15x Leica Total Stations") is the freshest; send it once Zein OKs it and delete the 28 Sep, 5 Oct and 12 Oct drafts.
Post "If you have it, we buy it" for RFP #452 (15 Leica monitoring total stations, urgent, valid to 13 Nov) on FB, IG and LinkedIn today. It's the biggest open request.
Last call for RFP #443 Leica TS15: it expires tomorrow (Sat 17 Oct) with 0 offers.
Post 1–2 sold success stories from the list below (anonymous, no buyer or seller names).
The new platform is going live (Levit, 16 Oct). Prepare a short launch post and newsletter line once Zein confirms it's live.
Emlid partners: 6 Emlid partnership and distribution pitches came in this week (Ghana, Kenya, others). Ask Zein whether to publish an "Become an Emlid reseller with Topotrade" post.
Add UTM tags to every social and newsletter link. GA4 shows 1 conversion and Odoo leads aren't source-tagged, so we can't tell what works.
Digital Realities: one Matterport Pro3 post on FR channels. 4 Pro3 cameras sold in October so far, so there's demand to build on; GA4 traffic is still near zero.
Ask Zein whether to restart Google Ads after billing is fixed, keeping only campaigns that converted.

Inbox items for you: Bourdin Business podcast invite (casting closes in about 2 days, Zein to decide) and ADIPEC 2–5 Nov. The rest of this week's marketing mail is vendor newsletters and promotions, no action.
